title: SessionPing
description: The vertical slice of the bootstrap: it crosses every layer without touching the Agent SDK. Omitting `sessionId` opens a session; sending one pings that session.

sessionId.description: Session to ping. Absent opens a new one, and the pong carries the id it got.

nonce.description: Echoed back in the pong, so a client can tell its own round trip from someone else's on the same session.
